selection.eligibility_rule: Compute each matched group's maximum absolute predator coordinate over all three labels and valid prefixes; retain groups at or below the global higher-method 90th percentile, then sample within checkpoint-seed strata.
selection.background_rule: Within each eligible seed stratum, sort matched reset keys by SHA-256 of salt|checkpoint_seed|env_key_word_0|env_key_word_1 and select the first 40.
selection.highlight_rule: Within each checkpoint-seed stratum, select two deterministic joint medoids over robust-standardized, time-resampled predator paths and behavior vectors from all three labels.

claim_boundary: These are behavior rollouts from trained specialists. The bundle does not by itself establish representation recovery or downstream scientific success.
